issues.title: Clarify Smeaton2009 plumbojarosite assay versions, microscopy preparation and lead accounting
Clarify loellingite phase-recovery calculations and surface-component claims in Almojadah & Harmer 2025
Clarify metal normalization, control accounting and assay labels in the 2020 machining-burr bioleaching study

selection: Four mineral species and one secondary resource: controlled bacterial reduction of synthetic plumbojarosite; culture- and supernatant-associated flotation of a loellingite-bearing mixture; primary natural-crystal identity and field alteration context for woodhouseite and svanbergite; and culture-associated acidification with limited metal mobilization from machining burrs. These claims preserve their experimental forms, controls and uncertainty. They do not inherit criticality from constituent elements or imply industrial recovery.
validation: Baseline and final just check passed (317 tests, 3 skipped). Strict nonempty-corpus validation, append-only history, generated pages and native structured reviews passed. Every current record matches a completed positive scientific review by ID, target path and exact SHA-256. All five new reviews are independent. No schema, validator, test or governed-file change was needed.
remaining_priorities: Resolve the new source-clarification issues before strengthening phase recovery, intracellular phosphate or burr extraction claims. Their supported limitations are already represented in the records.
Continue earlier source follow-ups, including #316 and #317; the new records do not resolve those different studies.
Assess the remaining Smeaton dissertation chapters and distinct natural/synthetic jarosite studies separately; this five-record batch is not evidence that the material frontier is exhausted.
Investigate deferred primary resource and mineral leads only when complete, relevant evidence can be acquired; retain unqualified candidates in research.
Verify PR-shepherd credentials and a controlled dry run through CLAW-supported processes. The installed manual/comment-only workflow has zero observed runs; operational readiness is unproven.
scope_limits: Bounded source review, not frontier exhaustion. Raw originals and derived graphics remain outside Git. These are completed local checks; hosted PR/queue/merge and fresh-main checks are subsequent publication gates.
